versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02079, SRS_Com_02087 If the configured ComSignalDataInvalidValue is received for a signal and the ComDataInvalidAction is configured to REPLACE for this signal, the AUTOSAR COM module shall replace the signal’s value by its configured ComSignalInitValue . After the replacement, the normal signal processing like filtering and notification shall take place as if the ComSignalInitValue would have been received instead of the ComSignalDataInvalidValue .
